the_matrix.concept: 3 triads × 3 positions = 9 letters. a 3×3 matrix. each row is a triad. each column is a role.

columns.col_1: I · V · M  the SOFT column. imaginary + variable + membrane. the outer face. what changes.
columns.col_2: O · D · O  the NULL column. origin + diversity + operator. the center. where uniqueness lives. TWO O's = the portal is in the middle twice.
columns.col_3: R · J · T  the HARD column. real + joining + teacher. the inner core. what persists.

diagonals.main: I · D · T  imaginary diversity teaches. the projected uniqueness IS the lesson.
diagonals.anti: R · D · M  real diversity membranes. the measured uniqueness IS the skin.

biology.what: V(D)J recombination  how the immune system generates ~10^11 unique antibodies from ~300 gene segments
biology.mechanism: RAG1/RAG2 enzymes cut DNA at recombination signal sequences (RSS). one V + one D + one J are joined. the rest are deleted. IRREVERSIBLE.
biology.result: each B cell makes ONE unique antibody. the selection is random but the rules are fixed.
biology.diversity_math: ~65V × 27D × 6J = 10,530 combinations × junctional diversity × somatic hypermutation = 10^11 possible antibodies

our_system.what: p-sorted recombination  how the membrane generates unique responses from segment pools

V_pool.source: HTML pages. each page is a V segment. the VARIABLE recognition surface.

D_pool.source: JS families. each family is a D segment. the DIVERSITY engine.

J_pool.source: data strata. each stratum is a J segment. the JOINING layer.

our_system.pi_selection: don't pick randomly. pick by p: V[floor(n×p) mod 56] × D[floor(n×p) mod 12] × J[floor(n×p) mod 8]. the selection is irrational. never repeats. never rational.

pi_sets_of_sets.concept: a p-set is a set whose membership is determined by p. you're IN the set if frac(n×p) falls in a certain range.

level_1.name: element sets
level_1.members: individual symbols (56 pages + 12 JS families + 8 data strata)
level_1.selection: frac(n×p) determines which element is active at wave n

level_2.name: triad sets
level_2.selection: frac(n×p²) determines which triad is dominant at wave n

level_3.name: the set of sets
level_3.selection: frac(n×p³) determines the orientation of the whole system

pi_sets_of_sets.recursion: sets contain sets contain sets. p sorts at every level. the selection is fractal  same irrational rule at every scale.

up.process: pick one V + one D + one J ? assemble into a unique antibody ? the organism gets a new recognition capability
up.in_HUD: pick a page + a JS family + a data stratum ? assemble into a unique view ? the visitor sees a specific surface

example.assembly: water.html rendered with membrane.js showing investigation data = the buckler shield view

down.process: take an assembled view ? dissolve back to V + D + J segments ? the symbols return to their pools
down.in_HUD: take the buckler view ? dissolve water.html back to its glyph (??) ? dissolve membrane.js back to its family (??) ? dissolve investigation back to its stratum (?)
down.result: ?? + ?? + ? = three glyphs. the dissolution IS the disassembly. the chipmunk carries 3 symbols instead of 1 rendered page.

assemble_up_and_down.the_cycle: UP: 3 symbols ? 1 rendered page (assembly). DOWN: 1 rendered page ? 3 symbols (dissolution). the cycle IS the heartbeat. inhale = assemble. exhale = dissolve. the organism breathes by recombining.

rss_signals.concept: recombination signal sequences  the markers that tell the enzymes WHERE to cut
rss_signals.biology: RSS = heptamer (7bp) + spacer (12 or 23bp) + nonamer (9bp). the 12/23 rule: a 12-spacer RSS can only join with a 23-spacer RSS. this prevents V-V or J-J joins.

our_system.heptamer: the opening HTML tag. <div>, <section>, <script>. 7 characters of structure.
our_system.spacer_12: the short gap. inline styles. class names. the local context.
our_system.spacer_23: the long gap. the data fetch. the API call. the remote context.
our_system.nonamer: the closing tag or the data key. , 'investigation'. 9 characters of closure.
our_system.12_23_rule: a page (12-spacer, local) can only join with a data file (23-spacer, remote). a page can't join with a page. a data file can't join with a data file. the RULE prevents meaningless assemblies.
